author: sebasav182

status.label: Duplicate or handled
status.detail: The same SVG thumbnail performance problem is tracked in #19690.

judgment.rationale: The performance symptom is already represented by #19690 and #24393, which describe minute-scale SVG thumbnail generation for folders with many files. A new competing fix plan should not be created under this duplicate.
evidence: The report gives a current screenshot and a repeatable folder-size threshold on PowerToys 0.100.2.
Issue #24393 was closed as a duplicate of #19690 for the same extremely slow SVG preview/thumbnail behavior.
Current provider code starts a separate thumbnail executable and initializes WebView2 for each requested SVG, consistent with high cold-start cost.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as a duplicate of #19690 and keep performance investigation centralized there.

fix_assessment.rationale: The defect is already tracked by the existing SVG thumbnail performance issue; this report adds current confirmation but should not create duplicate implementation work.

issue_context.summary: Explorer renders a folder of roughly 50 SVG thumbnails serially, with each first-time thumbnail taking several seconds.
known_information: On first opening a directory with at least 50 SVG files, each thumbnail takes about 4–5 seconds.
Older #19690 and #24393 describe the same folder-level SVG thumbnail slowdown.
inferences: Per-file helper-process and WebView2 startup likely contributes substantially to the serial latency, but the canonical issue should own validation and design.
issue_context.analysis: The report is actionable evidence for the existing performance problem, not a distinct bug. The current architecture supports the reported cold-start cost, strengthening the duplicate link.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue through 2026-08-26T15:24:16Z.
Verified #24393 was closed as duplicate of #19690, whose report also describes tens of SVGs taking nearly a minute.

Reviewed SvgThumbnailProviderCpp::GetThumbnail and SvgThumbnailProvider::GetThumbnailImpl: each request writes a temporary file, launches PowerToys.SvgThumbnailProvider.exe, waits synchronously, creates a WebView2 environment, renders, and captures a bitmap.

comment.body: Thanks for the current 0.100.2 confirmation and screenshot. This matches the SVG thumbnail performance problem already reported in #19690 (with #24393 also consolidated into it): opening a folder with tens of SVG files incurs multi-second thumbnail generation and long serial completion time. I suggest closing this issue as a duplicate of #19690 and adding the “about 50 files, 4–5 seconds each on Windows 11 25H2” measurement there so performance work stays in one thread.

title: Render svg preview images in File Explorer is too slow
